specs.title: TC-01: Login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: 1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the wrong password
3. Open the account menu
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu

specs.title: TC-02: Add a product to the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Add the product to the basket
3. Open the basket
4. Read the basket total

specs.title: TC-03: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the basket
2. Increase the quantity of product A
3. Decrease the quantity of product A
4. Decrease the quantity of product A again
5. Remove product A

specs.title: TC-05: Valid coupon on the payment step

steps.title: 1. Open the basket and click Checkout
2. Select the saved address and continue
3. Select One Day Delivery and continue
4. Redeem the coupon of the current month
5. Select the saved card and continue

specs.title: TC-06: Invalid coupon and expired coupon

steps.title: 1. Checkout with the saved address
2. Select One Day Delivery and continue
3. Redeem an invalid code
4. Redeem the coupon of the previous month
5. Select the saved card and continue

specs.title: TC-07: Order with a card, from basket to order history

steps.title: 1. Add product A two times and product B one time
2. Open the basket
3. Checkout with the saved address
4. Select One Day Delivery and continue
5. Redeem the coupon of the current month
6. Select the saved card and continue
7. Place the order
8. Read the order summary on the confirmation page
9. The basket is empty
10. Open the order history
1. Checkout with the saved address
2. Select Standard Delivery and continue
3. The wallet button is disabled
4. No order in the order history
5. The wallet balance is 5.00
Before step 6: add 3.99 to the wallet with the saved card
6. Checkout again
7. Pay with the wallet
8. Place the order
9. The wallet balance is 1.00
10. One order in the order history
